name: Fabious Verritti
original_name: ファビウス・ベルリッティ
source: The frank and carefree father of Carina, husband of Fiore, and current duke of Ert'Aria. Tends to flirt with good-looking women (especially Minette) unless kept in check by Carina, Nina, or Fiore. Former adventurer, along with Nagan, Shelley, and Mise, and friends with Chelsea ever since. Specializes especially in hand-to-hand combat.
